race.comment: SHORTS FURY (5) gets the nod off a debut fourth at this track in the Mdn won by Andless Love, where she jumped awkwardly and was beaten just over a length as the short odds-on favourite. That beaten-favourite tag is a query, but the run still contained enough substance for a two-year-old having her first start and she should take benefit second-up with class relief. MR STRONG (1) is the immediate danger after finishing second in that same race, beaten a nose, and he did have SHORTS FURY behind him. His debut at Townsville was plain but came with a wide run, so the latest effort is the truer guide. MORNING GLORY (7) also comes through that form line, finishing fifth after holding her ground until the final 150m, and she looks the next improver with place claims. GREY DEVIL (8) has not shown the same sharpness, but third-up fitness, barrier 1 and class relief give her some way into the minor money if she can lift on her sixth here last start.
